newsitem.title: NORWAY: Nera shares jump 7 pct on Q2 profits.
newsitem.headline: Nera shares jump 7 pct on Q2 profits.

text.p: Shares in Norwegian telecommunications company Nera ASA rose more than seven percent in active trade on Wednesday after the company released results for the first six months of the year.
Nera advanced to 7.07 percent, or 3.50 crowns, to 53 crowns soon after the open of trade on the Oslo bourse in trade worth almost 20 million crowns.

Nera beat market expectations to post second-quarter operating profits up 28 percent at 45.4 million crowns and a pre-tax profit of 40 million crowns, a rise of more than 10 million crowns from the corresponding year-ago quarter.
